identity.name: Variational Omni Berkshire Hathaway Inc. Class B Perp

about.description: BRKB is a single-stock perpetual on Variational tracking Berkshire Hathaway Inc. Class B. Berkshire Hathaway Class B represents non-voting Class B shares of Warren Buffett's multinational holding company (NYSE: BRK.B). The market is cash-settled with hourly funding, no shareholder rights, and no dividend rights in the underlying.
